name: Secret Recipe
summary: A Mother's Day card: a recipe book opens, the ingredients fly into a bowl and a heart cake with her name rises
about: A warm kitchen counter with green tiles, a red pendant lamp and three jars on the shelf. A red recipe book on its stand swings open and writes itself in by hand: a list of what goes into the best mum (two cups of patience, a pinch of midnight chai, endless hugs) and a method that ends with serving it with a hug. Each ingredient ticks itself off and flies into the mixing bowl, the whisk stirs, and a heart-shaped cake with her name piped on top pops up on a cake stand in a shower of sprinkles. Write your own five ingredients, a message and who it is from, then copy a link that opens the card made for her.
how: Open the page: the book opens, the recipe writes itself and the ingredients fly into the bowl one by one until the cake is baked.
Tick the ingredients in the book yourself, or press Bake it to add the rest and bake straight away.
Tap the sugar, flour or love jars for a pinch, tap the cake for sprinkles, and press Start over for a fresh page.
In Make yours, type what you call her, who it is from, up to five ingredients (one per line) and a message, or pick a ready one.
Copy the link (or Share on a phone) and send it; it opens this kitchen with your recipe in the book and her name on the cake.
